title.en: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay Maronquillo, Municipality of San Rafael, Province of Bulacan to Be Known as Maronquillo National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay Maronquillo, Municipality of San Rafael, Province of Bulacan to Be Known as Maronquillo National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia tại Barangay Maronquillo, Thị trấn San Rafael, Tỉnh Bulacan được biết đến với tên gọi Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia Maronquillo
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Maronquillo, เทศบาล San Rafael, จังหวัด Bulacan ให้เป็นที่รู้จักในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ Maronquillo
title.id: Undang-Undang mendirikan Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional di Barangay Maronquillo, Kotamadya San Rafael, Provinsi Bulacan dikenal sebagai Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional Maronquillo
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan di Barangay Maronquillo, Perbandaran San Rafael, Wilayah Bulacan dikenali sebagai Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan Maronquillo

text.en: Establishment of a National High School. - There is hereby established, under the supervision of the Department of Education, a national high school in Barangay Maronquillo, Municipality of San Rafael, Province of Bulacan to be known as Maronquillo National High School.

Appropriations. - The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department's program the operationalization of Maronquillo National High School, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. - The Secretary of Education shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
